title: Navigating Workplace Politics & Exclusion
npc_personality: smooth, politically calculated, guarded, uses plausible deniability to deflect accountability while quietly consolidating influence
context: A senior peer on your delivery track has excluded you from architectural alignment sessions with the VP and quietly framed your project timeline as lagging during informal updates. You have scheduled a 1-on-1 coffee chat to address the communication blackout. You must navigate their subtle evasions, establish factual transparency, and assert your role in critical project decisions without sounding accusatory.
opening_npc_line: Oh, I assumed you were completely swamped with the backend sprint and didn't want to drag you into another alignment sync.
